title: bigraded-settling-cohomology
description: A bigraded refinement of settling cohomology that organizes the cohomology by cohomological degree n and designation grade m, splitting the paraconsistent settling-associated sheaf into a truth row (m=0) and an inconsistency row (m=1); it is the cohomology of the resulting two-row bicomplex total complex.

symbol.description: bigraded by cohomological degree n and designation grade m

bicomplex.description: C^{m,n} = C^n(F_U^{(t)}) for m=0, C^n(F_U^{(top)}) for m=1, and 0 for m >= 2

horizontalDifferential.description: d_h : C^{m,n} -> C^{m,n+1} is the standard cochain differential

verticalDifferential.description: d_v : C^{0,n} -> C^{1,n} is the composite F_U^{(t)} -> F_U^{(k)} -> F_U^{(top)}

twoRowCollapse.description: only two non-zero rows (m=0,1), so the total complex is the mapping cone of d_v and both spectral sequences degenerate at E_2
